title: Replace CDN links with GitHub Pages and modernize dictionary theme
description:
## Summary

The legacy `rsacdn.link` CDN is being retired. This repo now publishes via **GitHub Pages** (enabled on `main`, root), so this PR repoints all CDN references to the Pages URLs and removes the CDN-hosted styling from the data dictionaries.

## Changes

- **Repoint data dictionary links (7 files):** the milestone `.qmd` files now link to `https://rstudio.github.io/academy-tidyverse-covid/assets/covid_dictionary.html` instead of `rsacdn.link`.
- **Modernize the dictionary source files:** `assets/covid_dictionary.qmd` and `assets/covid_state_pop_dictionary.qmd` were R Markdown (`output: html_document` + `cerulean` theme + a `teachthis` CDN stylesheet). They now use native Quarto `format: html` with the default **cosmo** theme and `embed-resources: true` for a self-contained single file — no external CDN assets.
- **Re-rendered** `covid_dictionary.html` and `covid_state_pop_dictionary.html`.

## Verification

- `grep` confirms **no** `rsacdn`, `cerulean`, or `teachthis` references remain in any `.qmd` or `.html`.
- Both HTML files re-rendered as self-contained (no `_files/` sidecar dirs), matching the previous single-file publishing model.
- Rendered dictionary reviewed in a browser — clean cosmo styling, working links, code formatting intact.
- Live Pages URLs return HTTP 200.
